credits.title: Merri Boys
credits.overview: Set around a close-knit group of young friends, the story explores modern relationships, emotional uncertainty, and the blurred lines between companionship and romance

credits.title: Kattalan
credits.overview: Power-hungry forces clash in the Ivory cartel war-a fierce story of control, vengeance, and survival where compassion vanishes and only the ruthless endure.

credits.title: Alappuzha Gymkhana
credits.overview: A group of youngsters, after failing their plus two exams, aims to join a common college through the sports quota. They choose boxing as their sport. By luck, they manage to survive the district-level competitions. But what will happen at the higher levels?
